form_faults.name: Knee Valgus
form_faults.feedback_message: Push your knees out! They are caving in.

form_faults.name: Excessive Forward Lean
form_faults.feedback_message: Keep your chest up! Don't lean too far forward.

form_faults.name: Hip Flexion Bottom
form_faults.feedback_message: Your hips are collapsing! Maintain a neutral spine.

form_faults.name: Heel Lift
form_faults.feedback_message: Keep your heels flat on the floor!

form_faults.name: Back_Rounding
form_faults.feedback_message: Keep your back straight! Do not round your upper back.
